_comment: Model catalog served by GET /v1/models. Two rules learned the hard way:
never list a model you have not actually called, because an unknown name returns
HTTP 400 unknown model, which clients often report as a context-length error;
and remember that the n8n AI Agent node requires tool calling, so a model in
Availability differs per account and region: verify against your own account.
The service mounts this file from a stage and re-reads it, so adding a model is a
file upload with no image rebuild.
